title: Rabbi Zemina
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was Rabbi Yonah’s colleague, as is evident from Bikkurim, chapter 3, end of halakhah 3, where it says: Rabbi Zemina was in Tyre, and they appointed him on condition that he return [to the Land of Israel]; Rabbi Yonah too was in Pitka and would not accept an appointment.

notes.text: In the Guggenheimer digital Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 3:3, appointment outside the Land is discussed on condition of returning. This supports return to the Land of Israel, rather than repayment. The inference that Zemina and Yonah were colleagues remains Hyman’s.
In the consulted Yerushalmi, Zemina’s appointment is conditional on his return. Hyman infers that he was Yonah’s colleague from the juxtaposition of the two accounts.
